integrity: The proof reconstructs the CDV condition under joins and complete multipartite false-twin parts. The verifier independently enumerates proper colorings, computes closed-neighborhood color sets, tests b-colorings, and compares exact realization counts.
scientific_limitations: The join factorization is stated for finite simple connected nonempty factors, matching the initiating paper's graph scope.
The complete-multipartite classification does not automatically extend to arbitrary cographs or substitutions with nonempty internal graphs.
The finite verifier checks small graphs and part profiles only; the general result is analytic.
title: Join convolution for sequence b-colorings
